pages.text: $(#556B2F)🌳 Ancient Wood Morning Dew · Triple Blessing 🍎$()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)「Drink this autumn gift and let the winds of fate forever be by your side」$()$(br)When the richness of $(#6B8E23)Aged Oolong$() meets the crisp sweetness of $(#FF4500)Frost-Touched Apples$(), and $(#DAA520)Rock Honey$() embraces the blessings of $(#8A2BE2)Gaura$()—a legendary blend is formed, granting $(l)Speed, Strength, and Luck$() to adventurers.

$(#6B8E23)▌ Autumn’s Triple Melody $()$(br2)$(l)$(#000080)⚡ Mountain Gale Dash$()$(br)Footsteps glide like a deer leaping over pine needles.$(br2)$(l)$(#006400)🍀 Four-Leaf Awakening$()$(br)Even $(#8A2BE2)Amethyst Veins$() reveal themselves in your presence.$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)💪 Oakwood Strength$()$(br)Muscles pulse with the energy of ancient tree rings.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)▌ Secret Brewing Process $()$(br)- Roast $(#6B8E23)Oolong Tea Leaves$() until they emit a $(#8A2BE2)purple sandalwood fragrance$().$(br)- $(#FF4500)Apple Juice$() must be filtered three times using a $(#4682B4)fine sieve$().$(br)- When adding $(#8A2BE2)Gaura Powder$(), one must chant the $(#556B2F)Ancient Tree Prayer$().$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() The tea reaches its peak state when a $(#228B22)jade-green halo$() forms on the surface.

$(br2)$(#4B0082)『 Hymn of Autumn Harvest 』$()$(br)The elven festival of abundance sings:$(br)'Raise this cup of $(#6B8E23)Ancient Wood$() and $(#FF4500)Fresh Fruit$(),$(br)let the $(#000080)mountain winds$() embrace your steps, and$(br)let $(#006400)Luck$() rest upon your shoulders—$(br)for $(#8B0000)Strength$() shall be rooted deep in your $(#8A2BE2)Amethyst Core$() forever.'
